verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the SDK's code lives in a public GitHub repository (github.com/openai/openai-agents-python), whose README describes the provider-agnostic, voice and realtime agent features, so users can plausibly read the source. However, nothing in the pack states which license the code is released under, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache LICENSE file), confirmation that the full source rather than just a README is publicly readable, independent corroboration.
